svg.aria-label: qutrek-video, a native video engine: three player slots (previous kept warm, current playing, next prerolled on its first frame). iOS in Swift with AVFoundation, Android in Kotlin with Media3 and AV1 via dav1d, bridged with C++ through Nitro.

g.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

g.text: Swipe, and the next video is already on its first frame.
